div.div: Optional feature depending on application. Enters the Safe State, then transitions to deep sleep modes and periodically wakes up to manage the Watchdogs before going back to sleep. The Task Manager will maintain the Shutdown state until a user defined condition is set, indicating that the application is ready to go back into Mission Mode. This will trigger a device reset, which will execute the pre-startup and startup sequence again, before entering Mission Mode. This is required since deep sleeping is not considered safe due to several safety mechanisms being disabled, and the Startup routine must re-initialize the safety system.
